The '''Dwarvish Sentry''' is an [[Monsters|enemy]] found in the [[Volcano Dungeon]].  It has a 19% chance to spawn from a broken [[Volcano Dungeon#Metal Crates|metal crate]].<ref name="cratedrop" />

==Behavior==
They move extremely slowly and are immune to [[weight|knockback]].
